physicalNotes: Radius 0.666 +/- 0.034 solar radii from Rowe et al. 2014, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of Kepler-220 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...784...45R/abstract): 463,336 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.729 +/- 0.0185 solar masses from Weiss et al. 2024, the stellar mass of Kepler-220 e's parameter set from Weiss et al. 2024 (the default leaves it empty) in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024ApJS..270....8W/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 4632 +/- 100 K from Rowe et al. 2014, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of Kepler-220 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2014ApJ...784...45R/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
